answer_1.quote: ...Comment generation tries to automatically generate comments from code. ...We focus on two most studied code summarization tasks: comment generation and method naming...
datasets: Java open‑source projects collected from GitHub with timestamps

answer_2.quote: We used four automatic metrics that are frequently reported in prior work: BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and EM ... For method naming we used Precision, Recall, F1, and EM.
